evidence.title: GitHub - sadmann7/file-uploader: File uploader built with shadcn/ui and Radix UI. · GitHub

name: File Uploader
summary: Drag and drop file uploader for React with a reusable UploadThing hook, built on shadcn/ui and react-dropzone.
description: A file uploader built with shadcn/ui and react-dropzone on top of create-t3-app. It ships a reusable useFileUpload hook for uploading files with UploadThing, a drag and drop upload component with a progress bar, react-hook-form integration with shadcn/ui form components, and a file dialog demo that adds and removes files in a scrollable list. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Zod; live demo at uploader.sadmn.com; MIT licensed.
contains: drag and drop uploader with a progress bar
reusable useFileUpload hook backed by UploadThing
react-hook-form integration with shadcn/ui form components
file dialog demo with a scrollable file list
Next.js + Tailwind, Zod validation, MIT licensed
